continuity_conversation_help: Three short conversational questions discover characters, propose scenes with their starting sentences, and describe appearance. The app then saves profiles and aligns scenes to the audiobook. The model and token budget are configured in Video Storyboard.
continuity_flow_conversational: Characters + summary → Scenes + source sentences → Appearance → Place summary → Optional review → Separate JSON conversions → Align to audio → Image prompts. Scenes longer than 20 seconds receive shots of approximately 10 seconds.
storyboard_plan_intro: Choose how much continuity this audiobook needs. This step plans scenes; it does not generate images.
storyboard_content_help_scenes: For educational content and documentaries without recurring protagonists. Creates scenes without character or location profiles. Keeps the visual style and manually specified era.
storyboard_content_help_basic: For simple stories. Keeps one stable appearance for characters and places, without temporal states or automatic era detection.
storyboard_content_help_full: Creates editable initial character and location profiles. In this simplified flow, temporal changes and the historical period are adjusted manually, not extracted during summary conversion.
storyboard_review_choice: Review and edit the summary before generating scenes
storyboard_review_help: Analysis pauses so you can correct the summary. Save it and continue later. In Scenes only, this adds a short visual summary.

storyboard_review_instructions: Analysis is paused. Correct identities, appearance and places. Your edits take priority in the following stages; the original narration still determines timing.
storyboard_waiting_review: Analysis paused: waiting for summary review.
storyboard_review_saved: Review saved. Click Analyze audiobook to resume.
projects_folder_help: New projects are saved automatically in a subfolder here. Use Save As to choose another location.
video_storyboard_image_basic_help: Choose the image resolution and visual style. Advanced sampling settings are at the bottom of this page.
video_storyboard_image_advanced_help: Defaults are recommended for Z-Image Turbo. Change these only if your workflow requires it; not all providers support these parameters.
video_storyboard_final_video_help: Settings for the final rendered video, combining all scenes and audiobook audio.

review_library_help: Review generated segments, similarity scores, and transcripts.
review_page_subtitle: Inspect each generated segment and compare the transcript with the original text.
review_auto: Automatically review generated segments after generation
review_retries_layers_help: Automatic retries run when either enabled review layer does not pass. Each retry regenerates a candidate, transcribes it with Whisper, checks its audio tail, and keeps the best combined result.
review_tail_enable: Detect unexplained audio after the last valid word
review_tail_autocut: Automatically trim excessive tails and re-review with Whisper
review_tail_help: Whisper timestamps are aligned with the source text so trailing hallucinated syllables are ignored. The thresholds measure the remaining tail after the safety margin. Tail risk is a transparent severity estimate, not a model probability. Auto-cut removes only the part beyond the possible-artifact threshold, then sends the trimmed candidate back to Whisper and keeps it only if it reviews better. Generation Review also provides exact waveform and quick tail-cut tools.
review_tail_waveform_help: Click or drag the white line to seek. Listen around the end of the spoken text, place the line after the final valid sound, then choose Cut Here. Whisper will review the trimmed clip again.
review_tail_invalid_cut: Choose a point inside the audio clip.
review_tail_waveform_failed: Could not load the segment waveform: {message}
review_tail_cut_unavailable: Whisper did not provide a reliable last-word timestamp for this segment. Use Waveform & Cut to choose the point manually.
review_tail_cut_confirm: Segment {index} will end at {position:.2f} s, removing {removed:.2f} s. The trimmed WAV will replace this segment and Whisper will review it again. Continue?
review_tail_cutting: Cutting the audio tail for segment {index}...
review_tail_cut_complete: Audio tail removed. Starting Whisper review...
review_help: Faster Whisper small is downloaded on demand and used to transcribe generated segment WAV files for similarity scoring. When language is Auto, LocalText2Voice uses the segment language when available and falls back to Whisper auto-detection.
review_retries_help: Automatic retries only run for segments below the threshold. Each retry regenerates a candidate, transcribes it with Whisper, scores it, and keeps the best-scoring audio in the database.
review_rebuild_clean_tooltip: Rebuild the audiobook from current segment audio files.

custom_engine_help: Custom engines call an HTTP endpoint that returns WAV/PCM audio or JSON containing audio. Use placeholders like {{text}}, {{voice}}, {{language}}, {{speed}}, {{api_key}}, and {{output_path}}.
custom_engine_template_help: Templates can use {{text}}, {{voice}}, {{language}}, {{speed}}, {{model}}, {{api_key}}, and {{output_path}}. For JSON responses, use dot paths like audio.data or result.file.
custom_engine_invalid_message: Custom engines require at least a name and an endpoint URL.

local_server_intro: LocalText2VoiceEngineHost.exe is the shared background process used automatically by the desktop app and MCP stdio clients. It owns the job queue and keeps TTS models loaded between requests.
local_server_allow_lan_tip: Keep this off unless you need another device on your network to connect.
no_token_to_copy: There is no access token to copy yet.
local_server_one_job_tip: Heavy TTS models are safest with one generation job at a time.
local_server_status_text: Status: {status}. Internal port: {port}. It starts automatically when the desktop app or an MCP client needs it.
clip_not_resolved: This clip is not resolved yet. Run Whisper review first.
clip_outside_fast_preview: This clip is outside the fast first-minute preview.

audio_libraries_help: Manage background music and sound effects used by podcast mixes and PLAY markup.
remote_audio_sources_help: These links open in your browser. Review the license of each download before publishing it; free does not always mean attribution-free or commercial use.
remote_music_pixabay_description: 260,000+ royalty-free music tracks. The Pixabay Content License generally allows use without attribution, subject to its prohibited uses.
remote_music_mixkit_description: Free stock music organized by genre and mood under the Mixkit Stock Music Free License.
remote_music_fma_description: Original music under Creative Commons, public-domain or custom licenses. Check the license shown on every track.
remote_music_incompetech_description: Kevin MacLeod's royalty-free catalog. Free Creative Commons use requires visible attribution; a paid license is available when credit is not possible.
remote_music_youtube_description: Royalty-free production music in YouTube Studio. A Google sign-in is required and some Creative Commons tracks require attribution.
remote_sfx_pixabay_description: 120,000+ free sound-effect tracks under the Pixabay Content License, generally without required attribution.
remote_sfx_mixkit_description: Free MP3 and WAV effects for personal and commercial projects, with no sign-up or attribution required.
remote_sfx_freesound_description: A large community library of recordings, ambiences, loops and samples. Each sound has its own CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC license, so check attribution and commercial-use terms.
remote_sfx_zapsplat_description: 160,000+ effects. The free Basic account provides MP3 downloads and requires attribution; Premium removes that requirement.
remote_sfx_youtube_description: Downloadable MP3 sound effects inside YouTube Studio, searchable by category and duration. Google sign-in required.
delete_sfx_confirm: Delete {name} from the sound effects library?
audio_library_folders_help: Relative paths are resolved from the application folder. PLAY searches both folders recursively when only a filename is given.

engine_install_duration: Estimated time: {duration}. It may take longer depending on your internet connection, computer and storage speed.

normalization_auto_help: Auto uses the language reported by the selected voice. You can edit every starter dictionary or create and import one for another language.
normalization_reset_confirm_message: All edits, disabled entries, and custom entries in {name} ({language}) will be replaced with the starter defaults. Continue?
normalization_reset_done_message: The English dictionary was restored to its default entries.
normalized_text_placeholder: The normalized preview will appear here.
normalization_preview_stale: Preview pending. Normalize to review the spoken text.
normalization_preview_ready: Preview updated. This is the text that will be prepared for speech.
normalization_preview_no_dictionary: No dictionary matches the selected voice language. The original text is shown unchanged.
normalization_create_help: Use a language or locale code such as nl, ko, pt-br, or en-gb. The new dictionary starts empty and can be edited here or populated by importing JSON.

normalization_import_mode_message: {name} ({language}) already exists. Merge updates matching entries and keeps the rest. Replace removes all current entries first.

normalization_enable_rules_help: Turn all number, date, quantity, and Roman numeral rules on or off. Dictionary replacements remain active.
normalization_rules_dialog_help: Choose which structured values are converted before TTS. Turning a rule off preserves that value exactly, even when the general number rule remains on.
engine_repair_intro: Existing model files were detected. They will be reused, and only missing or updated runtime/model files will be downloaded. You can also run this again later to repair or update the engine.
ai_asset_storage_help: Downloaded models, engine dependencies, voice files, and caches are kept here. Choose a folder on another drive to keep large AI assets off the system drive.
storage_busy_message: Wait for generation or engine installation to finish before changing the storage location.
storage_host_stop_failed: The shared engine host could not be stopped. Close MCP clients and try again.

video_storyboard_scene_timing_help: The narration is divided by semantic meaning; these limits control the preferred duration of each visual scene.
video_storyboard_image_preset_help: The default values are recommended for the built-in Z-Image Turbo workflow.
video_storyboard_prompt_raw_help: Exact composed positive prompt. Editing it bypasses the fields below for this frame.
video_storyboard_raw_prompt_rebuilt_mess: Your manual Composed / Raw edit has been replaced because a structured prompt field changed.
video_storyboard_comfyui_recommendation: Recommended Z-Image Turbo setup: z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors in diffusion_models, qwen_3_4b.safetensors in text_encoders, and ae.safetensors in vae. ComfyUI should be started with its appropriate VRAM mode.

video_storyboard_service_unavailable: {service} is not reachable. Install/start it and check the URL. {error}
video_storyboard_detection_running_close: Video Storyboard is checking Ollama or ComfyUI. Wait for the connection check to finish before closing LocalText2Voice.
video_storyboard_generate_existing_confi: Some frames are already generated. They will be kept and only missing frames will be generated. Continue?
video_storyboard_delete_frame_confirmati: Delete this frame from the timeline? Its duration will be absorbed by the adjacent frame.
video_storyboard_frame_deleted: Frame {scene} was deleted and its duration was absorbed by an adjacent frame.
video_storyboard_video_generation_help: Choose a built-in or custom ComfyUI API workflow. The app supplies the scene image, prompt, seed, resolution, duration, FPS and output name.
video_storyboard_optional_bearer_token_h: Optional Bearer token for a protected remote ComfyUI
video_storyboard_ltx_prompt_enhance: Enable the workflow's LTX prompt enhancer
video_storyboard_open_ltx_video_workflow: Open bundled LTX 2.3 I2V workflow JSON
video_storyboard_ltx_requirements: The workflow owns its LTX checkpoint, text encoder, LoRAs, audio VAE and latent x2 upscaler. Recommended output: 1280 × 720 at 25 FPS.
video_storyboard_custom_workflow_help: Use placeholders such as {{IMAGE}}, {{PROMPT}}, {{SEED}}, {{WIDTH}}, {{HEIGHT}}, {{DURATION_SECONDS}}, {{FPS}}, {{FRAME_COUNT}} and {{OUTPUT_PREFIX}}. Alternatively bind a value as node-id.input-name below. Blank optional bindings keep the workflow's own value.
video_storyboard_open_wan_video_workflow: Open bundled Wan 2.2 video workflow JSON
video_storyboard_wan_requirements: Requires ComfyUI-GGUF plus: wan2.2-i2v-rapid-aio-v10-Q4_K.gguf, umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors, wan_2.1_vae.safetensors and clip_vision_h.safetensors.
video_storyboard_generate_video_help: The reference frame is always preserved. Accepting the candidate makes the scene use this clip instead of the still-frame motion.
video_storyboard_video_ready: Adjust the prompt and generate a video candidate. The current frame and any accepted clip remain unchanged until you accept.
video_storyboard_generate_all_videos_mes: Choose whether to generate only missing videos or regenerate every eligible scene.
video_storyboard_generate_all_videos_sum: Eligible scenes: {total} · Existing videos: {existing} · Missing videos: {missing}
video_storyboard_auto_video_no_eligible_: No scene with a generated frame is available for video generation.
video_storyboard_auto_video_no_targets: All eligible scenes already have a video.
video_storyboard_auto_video_complete: Automatic video generation finished: {completed}/{total} scenes accepted.
video_storyboard_video_candidate_ready: Video candidate ready. Play it before accepting or discarding it.
video_storyboard_unloading_comfyui_video: Freeing the current ComfyUI model from GPU memory...
video_storyboard_checking_comfyui_video: Checking ComfyUI video nodes and models...
video_storyboard_uploading_video_frame: Uploading the reference frame for scene {scene}...
video_storyboard_queueing_video: Sending scene {scene} to the ComfyUI video workflow...
video_storyboard_comfy_generating_video: ComfyUI is generating the video for scene {scene}...
video_storyboard_downloading_video: Downloading the generated video for scene {scene}...
video_storyboard_reversing_video: Placing the reference frame at the end of the clip...
video_storyboard_retiming_video: Fitting the generated clip to the complete scene duration...
video_storyboard_video_generation_busy: Another image or video is currently being generated.
video_storyboard_invalid_video_candidate: The generated video candidate is missing or invalid.
video_storyboard_video_generation_runnin: ComfyUI is generating a storyboard scene video. Wait for the candidate to finish before closing LocalText2Voice.
video_storyboard_frame_split_done: Frame {scene} was split into two equal timeline blocks.
video_storyboard_frame_cleared: Frame {scene} was cleared; its timeline space remains available.
video_storyboard_frame_replaced: Frame {scene} was replaced with an imported image.
video_storyboard_frame_replace_failed: The frame image could not be replaced: {error}
video_storyboard_invalid_replacement_ima: The selected file is not a readable image.
video_storyboard_resize_hint: Drag a frame edge to change its duration.
video_storyboard_empty_timeline: Generate or load a storyboard to display its scenes here.
video_storyboard_activity_empty: Generation and rendering progress will appear here.
video_storyboard_render_project_required: Save or open the audiobook project before rendering the video.
video_storyboard_render_audio_required: Generate the audiobook audio before rendering the video.
video_storyboard_render_started: FFmpeg started. Encoding {count} scenes with audiobook audio...
video_storyboard_render_encoding: FFmpeg is encoding the final video...
video_storyboard_render_running_close_me: FFmpeg is rendering the storyboard video. Wait for the MP4 file to finish before closing LocalText2Voice.
video_storyboard_analysis_ready: Scene plan ready. No frames have been generated yet.
video_storyboard_analysis_ready_count: Analysis complete: {count} scenes prepared; waiting for frame generation.
video_storyboard_invalid_plan: The LLM returned an invalid storyboard plan.
video_storyboard_plan_created: Video Storyboard created a plan with {count} scenes.
video_storyboard_analysis_running_close_: The LLM provider is analyzing the audiobook. Wait for the current planning block to finish before closing LocalText2Voice.
video_storyboard_frames_complete: All storyboard frames have been generated.
video_storyboard_generation_busy: Another frame is currently being generated.
video_storyboard_scene_missing: The selected scene no longer exists.
video_storyboard_generation_running_clos: ComfyUI is generating storyboard frames. Wait for the current frame to finish before closing LocalText2Voice.
video_storyboard_unloading_comfyui: Freeing ComfyUI GPU memory before analysis...
video_storyboard_project_direction: Project visual direction and video overrides
video_storyboard_style_gallery_help: Choose the visual look for every frame in this audiobook.
video_storyboard_frame_style_gallery_hel: Choose a visual style override for this frame only.
video_storyboard_era_automatic: Automatic (present day when the text gives no historical clues)
video_storyboard_seed_help: Use the same seed to reproduce the same image-generation sequence.
video_storyboard_analysis_reasoning_disa: Reasoning is disabled for constrained JSON requests because it can make small local models truncate or repeat their structured response.
video_storyboard_analysis_retry: The response was incomplete ({reason}). Retrying automatically with a compact anti-repetition request...
video_storyboard_candidate_not_generated: Generate a candidate to compare it here
video_storyboard_regenerate_ready: Adjust the frame and generate a candidate. The current image is preserved until you accept.
video_storyboard_analysis_stream_note: Live responses are shown when supported by the selected LLM provider. Partial plans are saved after every completed block.
video_storyboard_analysis_started: Analysis started. Releasing image-model memory before contacting the LLM provider.
video_storyboard_analysis_fixed_block: Prepared fixed semantic assignments for block {current}/{total} ({start:.2f}s–{end:.2f}s).
video_storyboard_analysis_request: Sending {label} to {model}: {scenes} fixed scenes, up to {tokens} output tokens.
video_storyboard_analysis_response_compl: Received and validated {characters} response characters for {label}.
video_storyboard_analysis_partial_saved: Block {current}/{total} validated and saved ({scenes} frames currently planned).
video_storyboard_analysis_dialog_complet: Analysis complete: {count} frames planned and saved.
video_storyboard_analysis_cancelling: Cancelling analysis after the current LLM request...
video_storyboard_zoom_travel_help: Total smooth zoom applied from the first to the last frame of each scene.
video_storyboard_regenerating_all_frames: Regenerating every frame with the project visual direction...
video_storyboard_reanalyze_warning: Analyzing this audiobook again will permanently replace the current scene plan and its frame references. Generated image files will not be deleted, but they will no longer belong to the new plan. Continue?
video_storyboard_generate_frames_dialog_: Images will be created for the planned scenes using the image provider and generation parameters configured in Video Storyboard settings.
video_storyboard_regenerate_all_dialog_i: Images will use Project visual and video overrides. Any value not overridden by this project falls back to Video Storyboard settings.
video_storyboard_frame_batch_ready: Review the options, then start generation.
video_storyboard_frame_batch_log_placeho: Detailed generation activity will appear here.
video_storyboard_cancelling_frame_genera: Cancelling after the current model request...
video_storyboard_edit_frame_help: Changes are non-destructive: a new image is saved only when you accept. The original frame remains available through Undo.
video_storyboard_use_previous_video_last: Use final frame from previous scene video
video_storyboard_previous_frame_loaded: Final frame loaded. Apply to use it for this scene.
video_storyboard_previous_frame_failed: Could not extract the previous video's final frame.
video_storyboard_invalid_edited_image: The edited frame is not a valid image.
video_storyboard_analysis_explanation: The AI will first build character, location and era continuity, then bind every timed narration unit and create the visual scene plan. No images are generated during this step.
video_storyboard_reanalyze_warning_compa: Warning: continuing will replace the current scene plan and its frame references. Existing image files will not be deleted.
video_storyboard_analysis_input_size_hel: Higher values send more timed narration in each request and reduce the number of calls, but require a model with a larger context window.
video_storyboard_analysis_output_size_he: Maximum response budget for each analysis request. The model may finish before reaching it.
video_storyboard_analysis_limits_note: Use larger values only with capable models such as GPT-5.5 and a sufficiently large context window. The defaults are safer for local 8B models.
video_storyboard_character_name_required: Enter a canonical name for the new character.
video_storyboard_delete_character_confir: Delete {name} and all of this character's visual states? Scene references will also be removed.
video_storyboard_invalid_image_detail: The selected file could not be opened as an image.
storyboard_camera_drag: Drag the green orbit, purple elevation or amber distance handle. This is a schematic, not an AI preview.
storyboard_camera_off: No camera change. The camera LoRA will not be loaded.
storyboard_edit_disabled: Configure an image editor in Settings → Video Storyboard.
storyboard_camera_comfy_only: Camera controls require Qwen Edit with ComfyUI and the Multiple-angles LoRA.
storyboard_camera_install: Install the Multiple-angles LoRA in ComfyUI/models/loras. Enter its filename (including any subfolder) above. Loaded only when Change camera is active in Edit frame.
storyboard_engine_runtime_description: Use local Ollama and ComfyUI models with an NVIDIA GPU (8 GB VRAM minimum), or connect remote models over HTTP(S) with their API keys. Default engines and models are optional: download them only when you choose Install.
storyboard_install_help: Installs the default engine, workflow, required nodes and models. Existing models are reused and interrupted downloads can resume. Nothing starts until you press Install.
storyboard_install_size: Full model package: {size} on disk. Python/runtime dependencies need additional space. Shared files reduce the download.
storyboard_install_python_auto: Auto-detect; created automatically for a new installation
storyboard_install_camera: Include the optional Multiple-angles camera LoRA
storyboard_install_use: Use this default engine in Video Storyboard after installation
storyboard_install_remote: Remote service: HTTP access cannot install files or Python dependencies on that host. Export the package for installation there, or choose localhost to install on this computer.
storyboard_install_ollama_storage: An existing Ollama service keeps its own model storage. A service started by this installer uses the app's AI models storage.
storyboard_install_destination: Models will be installed in: {path}. All three ComfyUI engines share this directory.
storyboard_install_cancelling: Cancelling… waiting for the current operation to stop.
storyboard_install_success: Installation verified. The default engine is ready.
storyboard_install_pending: Files installed. Restart ComfyUI and use Check engines to validate the new nodes and models.
storyboard_engine_operation_close: Video Storyboard is checking or installing engines. Cancel the installation and wait for it to stop before closing LocalText2Voice.
storyboard_custom_image_mapping_help: Load a ComfyUI API workflow JSON. Map values as node-id.input-name or use {{PROMPT}}, {{NEGATIVE_PROMPT}}, {{SEED}}, {{WIDTH}}, {{HEIGHT}}, {{STEPS}}, {{CFG}}, {{OUTPUT_PREFIX}}. Blank optional mappings preserve the workflow values.
storyboard_custom_image_connected: Connected to ComfyUI. Custom workflow nodes are checked before generation.
storyboard_profile_help: Each profile remembers its visual engines. Scene timing, style, final output and the analysis LLM stay independent.
runpod_rates: Estimated rates: image $0.005 · edit $0.02 · video $0.10/s at 720p or $0.15/s at 1080p. Video is generated in 5, 10 or 15 seconds. Verify current Runpod prices; retries may add cost.
runpod_reference_help: Runpod-generated images can be reused directly. Local or imported references need temporary storage. Qwen Edit uses its own output sizes. Analysis uses the LLM selected below; final video assembly runs on this computer.
runpod_reference_storage_help: Runpod-generated images can be reused directly. Choose temporary storage below for local references. Analysis uses the LLM selected below; final video assembly runs on this computer.
runpod_storage_notice: By selecting this option, local reference images are temporarily uploaded to the app operator's Cloudflare storage and shared with Runpod. Copies are deleted after generation; abandoned uploads expire after 24 hours and are cleaned periodically. Beta limits: 15 MB per image, 100 images or 500 MB per day. Runpod generation is billed separately.
runpod_storage_own_note: Enter your bucket and credentials under Advanced. Use a service supporting signed URLs, such as Cloudflare R2 or AWS S3. Runpod network-volume S3 does not support signed URLs.
runpod_auth_verified: Runpod authentication verified for all three endpoints. No generation was submitted; generation permissions, models and billing still need a generation test.
runpod_s3_help: S3 storage for local references: private objects are uploaded under localtext2voice/references/ and read through temporary URLs. Configure a bucket lifecycle rule to delete old references. Storage charges may apply. S3 credentials are separate from your Runpod API key.
runpod_jobs_help: To recover a job or download, generate again with the same prompt, seed and source images in the same project. The saved job is reused. Allow new generation only when you want another paid request; check unknown submissions in the Runpod console first.
runpod_cancel_first: Cancel the active job before allowing another generation.
runpod_reset_warning: Forget the recovery record? Generating again will create a new paid request. This does not cancel a remote job.
storyboard_mapping_help: Choose the node input for each value. Suggested matches are filled only when unambiguous. Review them before applying. Empty optional inputs keep the workflow value.
storyboard_video_unconfigured: Select a video provider in Settings > Video Storyboard.
runpod_batch_estimate: Estimated batch cost: {amount}. Recovered jobs are reused; additional generations may add cost. Check current Runpod prices. Start?
runpod_signup_affiliate: Create a Runpod account · affiliate link supporting LocalText2Voice
runpod_storage_automatic: Automatic setup for this installation. Before the first use, you will be asked to allow temporary image uploads to Cloudflare. Images expire after 24 hours. No account or beta code is needed.
runpod_storage_consent: To edit an image or generate a video, LocalText2Voice may temporarily upload reference images to Cloudflare so Runpod can read them. They are deleted when the job finishes and expire after at most 24 hours. A random installation identifier manages access and usage limits. Allow temporary uploads to {service}?
runpod_edit_preserve_size: Keep the first reference image's dimensions
runpod_model_rates: Image $0.005 · edit $0.02 · selected video: {price}. Indicative prices checked 2026-09-07; verify current Runpod prices.
runpod_camera_cost: Change camera: Qwen 2511 Multi-Angles - approximately $0.025 per image.
wan_behavior_split: Split and continue with the last frame (default)
wan_split_preview: On acceptance: {video:.3f} s of video + a continuation scene of {still:.3f} s using the last frame.
